_rationale: At age 72, SECURE 2.0 RMD does not yet apply (starts at 73). With 0% return, no spending, and no RMD, the portfolio is exactly $500,000 at the start of both age-72 and age-73 years. rmdRequired and rmdExcess are 0 for the age-72 year.

pathValues.note: Start of age-72 year — no RMD, balance unchanged
Start of age-73 year — balance unchanged from prior year because RMD applies during this year, not before it

breakdownChecks._note: No spending and no RMD at age 72
